Class SearchOperator.Builder

Enclosing class:

public static final class SearchOperator.Builder extends Object
Builder for SearchOperator. See the class Javadoc for an example. Start one with SearchOperator.create(String, String) or SearchOperator.copy().

    • typedArgs

      public SearchOperator.Builder typedArgs(boolean value)
      Opts this (custom) operator's SQL renderer into typed argument values.

      Built-in value operators ($eq/$ne/$in/$gt/$gte/$lt/ $lte/$between) always receive typed arguments from QueryResolver. For a custom operator, this flag controls only its SQL renderer: when true, a SQL context passes SearchExpression.typedArgs() instead of SearchExpression.literalArgs(). The in-memory SearchPredicate always receives literal strings regardless of this flag.

      Parameters:
      value - true for the SQL renderer to receive typed arguments.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • extension

      public <X> SearchOperator.Builder extension(Class<X> type, X value)
      Attaches a typed extension, keyed by its own Class.

      This is how a downstream module (for example juneau-beanquery-sql's SQL renderer) attaches its own metadata to a custom operator without this module (commons) ever depending on that module's types (design §5.3). Retrieve it later with SearchOperator.extension(Class).

      Type Parameters:
      X - The extension type.
      Parameters:
      type - The extension's class, used as the lookup key. Must not be null.
      value - The extension value. Can be null.
      Returns:
      This object.

    • build

      public SearchOperator build()
      Builds the immutable SearchOperator.
      Returns:
      A new, immutable operator.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If name is null or blank, help is null or blank on a custom operator, minArgs is negative, maxArgs is neither -1 nor >= minArgs, or this builder was seeded from copy() of a built-in operator and name has been changed since.
